وَٱلنَّجۡمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
By the star when it descends
By the star when it sets
He (may He be glorified) swore by the star when it descends.
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ وَالنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred
your companion has neither gone astray, nor amiss
Muhammad (peace be upon him) the Messenger of Allah did not deviate from the path of guidance nor did he go astray, but rather he is rightly-guided.
مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination
Nor does he speak out of [his own] desire
And he did not speak this Qur’ān out of following his desires.
وَمَا يَنْطِقُ عَنِ الْهَوَىٰ
إِنۡ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحۡيࣱ يُوحَىٰ
It is not but a revelation revealed
it is just a revelation that is revealed [to him]
This Qur’ān is nothing but a revelation which Allah revealed to him through the medium of Gabriel (peace be upon him)
إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ
عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡقُوَىٰ
Taught to him by one intense in strength
taught him by one of great powers
An angel of great strength, Gabriel (peace be upon him), taught him it.
عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ الْقُوَىٰ
ذُو مِرَّةࣲ فَٱسۡتَوَىٰ
One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
possessed of sound judgement. He settled
And Gabriel (peace be upon him) is of excellent form, so he rose up appearing to the Prophet (peace be upon him) in his form in which Allah created him.
ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَاسْتَوَىٰ
وَهُوَ بِٱلۡأُفُقِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon
while he was on the highest horizon
Whilst he was on the highest horizon.
وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَىٰ
ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
Then he approached and descended
Then he drew nearer and nearer
Then Gabriel (peace be upon him) came close to the Prophet (peace be upon him), then he came even closer.
ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوۡسَيۡنِ أَوۡ أَدۡنَىٰ
And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer
until he was within two bows’ length or even nearer
So his closeness to him was the distance of two bow lengths or even closer.
فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
فَأَوۡحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبۡدِهِۦ مَآ أَوۡحَىٰ
And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed
whereat He revealed to His servant whatever He revealed
So Gabriel (peace be upon him) revealed to Allah’s servant, Muhammad (peace be upon him), what he revealed.
فَأَوْحَىٰ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِ مَا أَوْحَىٰ
مَا كَذَبَ ٱلۡفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
The heart did not lie [about] what it saw
The heart did not deny what it saw
The heart of Muhammad (peace be upon him) did not lie about what his eye saw.
مَا كَذَبَ الْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰ
أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
So will you dispute with him over what he saw
Will you then dispute with him about what he saw
So do you, O idolaters, argue with him about what he saw on the night he was taken on the journey?
أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
وَلَقَدۡ رَءَاهُ نَزۡلَةً أُخۡرَىٰ
And he certainly saw him in another descent
Certainly he saw it yet another time
And Muhammad (peace be upon him) had seen Gabriel (peace be upon him) in his true form another time on the night he was taken for the journey.
وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
by the Lote Tree of the Ultimate Boundary
By the lote tree of the utmost boundary, which is a tree on the seventh heaven.
عِنْدَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَىٰ
عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلۡمَأۡوَىٰٓ
Near it is the Garden of Refuge
near which is the Garden of the Abode
By this tree is the Garden of Refuge.
عِنْدَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَىٰ
إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it]
when there covered the Lote Tree what covered it
When the lote tree was covered through the command of Allah by something great whose true nature only Allah knows.
إِذْ يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
مَا زَاغَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit]
His gaze did not swerve, nor did it overstep the bounds
The eye of Muhammad (peace be upon him) did not swerve left or right, nor did it trespass what was fixed for it.
مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
لَقَدۡ رَأَىٰ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰٓ
He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord
Certainly he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord
Muhammad (peace be upon him) saw on the night he was raised great signs of his Lord which show His power. He saw Paradise, hell and other things.
لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَىٰ
أَفَرَءَيۡتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلۡعُزَّىٰ
So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza
Have you considered Lat and ‘Uzza
Have you, O idolaters, seen these idols that you worship besides Allah: Lat and Uzza
أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّىٰ
وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰٓ
And Manat, the third - the other one
and Manat, the third one
And Manat, another third one amongst your idols? Tell me do they possess any benefit or harm for him?
وَمَنَاةَ الثَّالِثَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ
أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
Is the male for you and for Him the female
Are you to have males and He females
O idolaters, do you have boys whom you like, whilst He (may He be glorified) has girls which you dislike?
أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنْثَىٰ
تِلۡكَ إِذࣰ ا قِسۡمَةࣱ ضِيزَىٰٓ
That, then, is an unjust division
That, then, will be an unfair division
This distribution which you made with your desires is an unjust distribution.
تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰ

إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّآ أَسۡمَآءࣱ سَمَّيۡتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمۡ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلۡطَٰنٍۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهۡوَى ٱلۡأَنفُسُۖ وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلۡهُدَىٰٓ

They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance

These are but names, which you have coined—you and your fathers—for which Allah has not sent down any authority. They follow nothing but conjectures and the desires of the [lower] soul, while there has already come to them the guidance from their Lord

These idols are nothing but names without meaning, so they have no share of divine qualities. You and your fathers named them on your own part. Allah did not reveal any proof for them. The idolaters do not follow in their belief except assumption and what their souls desire from what the satan has adorned in their hearts. And the guidance has come to them from their Lord on the tongue of Muhammad (peace be upon him), but they were not guided.

إِنْ هِيَ إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ ۚ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنْفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمُ الْهُدَىٰ
أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
Or is there for man whatever he wishes
Shall man have whatever he yearns for
Or will man have what he desired i.e., the idols interceding with Allah?
أَمْ لِلْإِنْسَانِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةُ وَٱلۡأُولَىٰ
Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life]
Yet to Allah belong this world and the Hereafter
No, he will not have what he desired. For Allah alone is the afterlife and the first [life]; He grants of them whatever He wishes and withholds whatever He wishes.
فَلِلَّهِ الْآخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَىٰ
۞وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكࣲ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغۡنِي شَفَٰعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ أَن يَأۡذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡضَىٰٓ
And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves
How many an angel there is in the heavens whose intercession is of not any avail, except after Allah permits whomever He wishes and approves of

How many angels are there in the heavens whose intercession cannot help at all if they were to intend to help someone, except after Allah permits intercession for whom He wishes among them and He is pleased with the one being interceded for. Allah will never permit one who associates a partner with Him to intercede and He will never be pleased with the one he is interceding for who worships him besides Allah.
۞ وَكَمْ مِنْ مَلَكٍ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ وَيَرْضَىٰ
إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسۡمِيَةَ ٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names
Indeed those who do not believe in the Hereafter give female names to the angels
Those who do not believe in the resurrection in the afterlife give the angels female names in their belief that they are the daughters of Allah. Allah is far above what they say.
إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنْثَىٰ
وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱلۡحَقِّ شَيۡـࣰٔ ا
And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all
They do not have any knowledge of that. They follow nothing but conjectures, and conjecture is no substitute for the truth
In giving them female names they have no knowledge to base this on. They merely follow speculation. Speculation is of no value against the truth, to take its place.
وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهِ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا الظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا
فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life
So avoid those who turn away from Our remembrance and desire nothing but the life of the world

So, O Messenger, ignore those who turn away from Allah’s remembrance without showing any concern for it, and who want only the life of this world and therefore do not work for their Hereafter because they do not believe in it.
فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَنْ تَوَلَّىٰ عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا
ذَٰلِكَ مَبۡلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡعِلۡمِۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهۡتَدَىٰ
That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided
That is the ultimate reach of their knowledge. Indeed your Lord knows best those who stray from His way, and He knows best those who are [rightly] guided

That which the idolaters say - about giving the angels female names - is the limit of their knowledge because they are ignorant. They have not reached certainty. Your Lord - O Messenger- knows best about those who deviate from the path of truth and He knows best about those who are guided to its path. Nothing of that is hidden from Him.
ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَىٰ
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔواْ بِمَا عَمِلُواْ وَيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ بِٱلۡحُسۡنَى

And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward]
To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done, and reward those who do good with the best [of rewards]

To Allah alone belongs whatever is in the heavens and to Him alone belongs whatever is on earth. He created, owns and controls all of it. To recompense whose who do evil actions in the world with the punishment that they deserve and to repay the believers who do good actions with Paradise.
وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاءُوا بِمَا عَمِلُوا وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا بِالْحُسْنَى

ٱلَّذِينَ يَجۡتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلۡإِثۡمِ وَٱلۡفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلۡمَغۡفِرَةِۚ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِكُمۡ إِذۡ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَإِذۡ أَنتُمۡ أَجِنَّةࣱ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمۡۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓاْ أَنفُسَكُمۡۖ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ

Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him

Those who avoid major sins and indecencies, apart from [minor and occasional] lapses. Indeed your Lord is expansive in [His] forgiveness. He knows you best since [the time] He produced you from the earth and since you were foetuses in the bellies of your mothers. So do not flaunt your piety: He knows best those who are Godwary

Those who stay away from major sins and evil wrongs, besides minor sins as these are forgiven by leaving out the major ones and by an abundance of good deeds. Your Lord, O Messenger, is of vast forgiveness. He forgives the sins of His servants when they repent from them. He, (may He be glorified), knew best about their states and affairs when He created their father, Adam, from earth and when you were in the wombs of your mothers, being created in one form after another. Nothing of that is hidden from Him. So do not claim purity for your souls by praising them and asserting their piety. He, (may He be glorified), knows best about those who are mindful of Him, by fulfilling His instructions and avoiding His prohibitions.

الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنْتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اتَّقَىٰ
أَفَرَءَيۡتَ ٱلَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
Have you seen the one who turned away
Did you see him who turned away
Have you seen the evil state of the one who turned away from Islam after coming close to it?
أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّىٰ
وَأَعۡطَىٰ قَلِيلࣰ ا وَأَكۡدَىٰٓ
And gave a little and [then] refrained
gave a little and held off
He gave a little wealth and then held back, because miserliness was an innate quality in him. Despite this he declares his soul to be pure.
وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰ
أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees
Does he have the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees
Does he have knowledge of the Ghaib and therefore sees and speaks about the Ghaib?
أَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰ
أَمۡ لَمۡ يُنَبَّأۡ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
Has he not been informed of what is in the scriptures of Moses
Or is he fabricating against Allah? Or has this person, who makes up lies about Allah, not been informed about what was in the earlier scriptures that Allah had revealed to Moses?
أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
وَإِبۡرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَفَّىٰٓ
And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations]
and of Abraham, who fulfilled [his summons]
And the scriptures of Abraham who fulfilled everything His Lord tasked him with?
وَإِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّىٰ
أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةࣱ وِزۡرَ أُخۡرَىٰ
That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
that no bearer shall bear another’s burden
That no person will bear the sin of another.
أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
وَأَن لَّيۡسَ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
that nothing belongs to man except what he strives for
And that man will only obtain the reward of the action that he did.
وَأَنْ لَيْسَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
وَأَنَّ سَعۡيَهُۥ سَوۡفَ يُرَىٰ
And that his effort is going to be seen
and that he will soon be shown his endeavour
And that his action will be openly seen on the Day of Judgement.
وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
ثُمَّ يُجۡزَىٰهُ ٱلۡجَزَآءَ ٱلۡأَوۡفَىٰ
Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward
Then he will be given the recompense of his action in full without reduction.
ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَىٰ
وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
And that to your Lord is the finality
that the terminus is toward your Lord
And that to your Lord, O Messenger, will be the return and destination of the servants after they die.
وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ الْمُنْتَهَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
that it is He who makes [men] laugh, and weep
And that He makes whoever He wills happy and makes him laugh, and makes whoever He wills sad and makes him cry.
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحۡيَا
And that it is He who causes death and gives life
that it is He who brings death and gives life
And that He causes the living to die in the world and brings the dead to life by resurrection.
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوۡجَيۡنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلۡأُنثَىٰ
And that He creates the two mates - the male and female
that it is He who created the mates, the male and the female
And that He created the two types: Male and female.
وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَىٰ
مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ إِذَا تُمۡنَىٰ
From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
from a drop of [seminal] fluid when emitted
From a drop when it is placed in the womb.
مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
وَأَنَّ عَلَيۡهِ ٱلنَّشۡأَةَ ٱلۡأُخۡرَىٰ
And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
that with Him lies the second genesis
And that He will undertake to recreate them after they die for the resurrection.
وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشْأَةَ الْأُخْرَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغۡنَىٰ وَأَقۡنَىٰ
And that it is He who enriches and suffices
that it is He who enriches and grants possessions
And that He enriches whichever of His servants He wills by making him the owner of wealth and He gives wealth that people take as possessions they acquire.
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعۡرَىٰ
And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
And that He is the Lord of Sirius, the star that is worshipped by some idolaters together with Allah.
وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَىٰ
وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهۡلَكَ عَادًا ٱلۡأُولَىٰ
And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
that it is He who destroyed the former ‘Ad
And that He destroyed the first Ad, who were the people of Hud when they persisted in their disbelief.
وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَىٰ
وَثَمُودَاْ فَمَآ أَبۡقَىٰ
And Thamud - and He did not spare [them]
and Thamud, sparing none [of them]
And He destroyed the Thamud, the people of Salih, and did not spare any one of them.
وَثَمُودَ فَمَا أَبْقَىٰ
وَقَوۡمَ نُوحࣲ مِّن قَبۡلُۖ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ هُمۡ أَظۡلَمَ وَأَطۡغَىٰ
And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing
and the people of Noah before that; indeed they were more unjust and rebellious

He destroyed the people of Noah before the Ad and Thamud. The people of Noah were more unjust and transgressed even more than the Ad and Thamud, because Noah lived amongst them for nine hundred and fifty years inviting them to Allah’s oneness but they did not respond to him.
وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
And the overturned towns He hurled down
and He overthrew the town that was overturned
He raised the villages of the people of Lot to the sky and then dropped them to ground.
وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
And covered them by that which He covered
covering it with what covered it
He then covered them with stones after raising them to the sky and dropping them to the ground.
فَغَشَّاهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt
Then which of the bounties of your Lord will you dispute
So which of the signs of your Lord indicating His power do you dispute with, O man, and not take a lesson from?
فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
هَٰذَا نَذِيرࣱ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلۡأُولَىٰٓ
This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners
This is a warner, [in the tradition] of the warners of old
This messenger that is sent to you is from the class of the earlier messengers.
هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَىٰ
أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
The Approaching Day has approached
The Imminent [Hour] is near at hand
The Day of Standing has drawn nearer.
أَزِفَتِ الْآزِفَةُ
لَيۡسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover
There is none who may unveil it besides Allah
There is no one that can push it back and no one to uncover it besides Allah.
لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
أَفَمِنۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِ تَعۡجَبُونَ
Then at this statement do you wonder
Will you then wonder at this discourse
Do you marvel at this Qur’ān that is recited to you, that it is from Allah?
أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا الْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
وَتَضۡحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبۡكُونَ
And you laugh and do not weep
and laugh and not weep
And laugh mockingly at it and not cry when hearing its admonitions?
وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
وَأَنتُمۡ سَٰمِدُونَ
While you are proudly sporting
while you remain heedless
Whilst you are neglectful of it, not giving it any attention?
وَأَنْتُمْ سَامِدُونَ
فَٱسۡجُدُواْۤ لِلَّهِۤ وَٱعۡبُدُواْ۩
So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him]
So prostrate yourselves to Allah and worship Him
So prostrate to Allah alone, and dedicate your worship to Him.
فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ وَاعْبُدُوا ۩
